10. Occupation segregation is one of the main causes of the gender pay gap.206 Women’s
employment is concentrated in certain occupations, which are often the lowest paid:
cleaning, catering, caring, cashiering and clerical work.207 Many high-paying sectors
disproportionately comprise male workers, eg managers and senior officials, and workers in
skilled trade occupations.208
